key_fiscal_facts.value_text: 0% — RSC/HELP regime has no cost recovery mechanism. Government revenue share is biddable percentage of gross revenue; costs borne by contractor from revenue share net.

25.17% effective CIT (25% base + 7% surcharge for >INR 4B turnover + 4% cess = ~29.12% for large companies; 25.17% for eligible companies under Section 115BAA). No ring fence — consolidated with other income.
Onshore: 12.5% oil, 10% gas; Offshore: 10% oil, 10% gas; Deepwater: 5% oil, 5% gas
ONGC 58.9% government-owned; produces 71% of domestic upstream output
